newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian insurance firm ASTREE H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian insurance firm ASTREE H1 profits.

text.p: Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurances ASTREE net profits during the first half of 1996 amounted to 776,963 dinars, results published on Wednesday showed.
Figures for the same period last year were not available for comparison, but ASTREE reported a 1.95 million dinars net profit for the whole year 1995.

ASTREE, a privately-owned firm with a capital of four million dinars, has branches in Morocco and France. It is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange where its share was last priced at 16.68 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
